# Metrics

Generated by [`.github/workflows/pr-metrics.yml`](https://github.com/dawn-care/DAWN/blob/canary/.github/workflows/pr-metrics.yml)
on a nightly schedule (and on manual `workflow_dispatch`). Each run rebuilds the file here from
the full PR history and overwrites it. This README is copied from
[`.github/scripts/pr-metrics/README.md`](https://github.com/dawn-care/DAWN/blob/canary/.github/scripts/pr-metrics/README.md).

## `pull-requests.json`

Raw facts about every merged PR in this repo, collected by
[`.github/scripts/pr-metrics/main.mjs`](https://github.com/dawn-care/DAWN/blob/canary/.github/scripts/pr-metrics/main.mjs).
Nothing is filtered or computed here: the team site's `/metrics` page applies its own rules
(team, deadlines, focus areas, targets) and computes the PR metrics in the browser.

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "generatedAt": "<ISO time>",
  "repo": "dawn-care/DAWN",
  "pullRequests": [
    {
      "number": 485,
      "title": "...",
      "url": "https://github.com/dawn-care/DAWN/pull/485",
      "author": "<login>",
      "authorType": "User",
      "base": "canary",
      "head": "481-nighttime-hours-config",
      "createdAt": "<ISO time>",
      "readyAt": null,
      "mergedAt": "<ISO time>",
      "labels": ["<PR label>"],
      "closingIssues": [{ "number": 481, "labels": ["<issue label>"] }],
      "branchIssue": null,
      "reviews": [
        { "author": "<login>", "authorType": "User", "state": "APPROVED", "submittedAt": "<ISO time>" }
      ],
      "files": [{ "path": "caregiver/src/app.tsx", "additions": 10, "deletions": 2 }]
    }
  ]
}
```

- `authorType`: GitHub's account type (`User`, `Bot`, ...), so bots can be told apart even
  when their login has no `[bot]` suffix (Copilot's reviewer).
- `readyAt`: the last time the PR was marked ready for review, or `null` if it was never a
  draft.
- `closingIssues`: the issues the PR is linked to, with their labels.
- `branchIssue`: when the PR links no issue and its branch starts with a number
  (`481-...`), that issue and its labels; otherwise `null`.
- `reviews`: every submitted review, any state, including bots and the PR's own author.
- `files`: every changed file with its line counts, including tests, docs and lockfiles.
